note: Request side of the SOG Proposal Schema, assumed for the PoC from the synthetic archive. The schema workshop replaces it; extraction prompt, validation and review form all derive from this file.

fields.name: client_name
fields.label: Client
fields.hint: The organisation issuing the RFP and appointing the consultant, as written.

fields.name: country
fields.label: Country
fields.hint: Country where the project is built (not the client's or SOG's office).

fields.name: city
fields.label: City
fields.hint: City where the project is built.

fields.name: typology
fields.label: Typology
fields.hint: Primary building use of the project. For a project that is mainly a masterplan of a district or large site, use masterplan; a resort that includes a masterplan is still hospitality.

fields.name: gfa_m2
fields.label: GFA / BUA
fields.hint: Total gross floor area or built-up area (BUA) of the buildings in this appointment. Not component sub-areas, not areas stated as excluded from GFA (e.g. basement parking), not areas of other phases or existing buildings.

fields.name: fitout_area_m2
fields.label: Interior design area
fields.hint: Area covered by the interior design / fit-out scope.

fields.name: landscape_area_m2
fields.label: Landscape area
fields.hint: Area covered by the landscape scope.

fields.name: services
fields.label: Services
fields.hint: Design services the client asks this consultant to provide. One mention per service. Never include services the client says it will appoint others for (engineering, local architect of record, etc.).

fields.name: stage_package
fields.label: Stages
fields.hint: Design stages this consultant must deliver. One mention per stage, with the stage name exactly as written. Never include stages done by others.

fields.name: excluded_scope
fields.label: Excluded / by others
fields.hint: Each service or stage explicitly stated as not part of this appointment or done by others.

fields.name: special_requests
fields.label: Special requests
fields.hint: Each requirement outside a standard design appointment that could change scope or price (extra deliverables, certification support, unlimited revisions, specialist design, negotiation support).

fields.name: submission_deadline
fields.label: Submission deadline
fields.hint: Deadline for submitting the proposal, with time and time zone if stated.

fields.name: liability_cap
fields.label: Liability
fields.hint: Whether the client's terms cap the consultant's liability (capped) or make it unlimited (uncapped).

fields.name: payment_terms_days
fields.label: Payment terms (days)
fields.hint: Days within which the client pays invoices.
